name: RWC User Frontend – Submit Post, User Profile & Login at Frontend
author: Realwebcare

sections.description:
RWC User Frontend is a WordPress plugin created by Real Web Care (RWC) that allows users to manage their posts, update their profile, and log in, all from the front-end of your WordPress site. With an easy-to-use custom login form, users can quickly access their content. They can create new posts, edit existing ones, and remove posts when needed.

The plugin also provides a simple way to view a list of posts they’ve written and customize their profile with a personalized status. This all-in-one solution offers full control over content management directly from the front-end, without the need to access the WordPress admin panel.

Watch Free Version Video Walkthrough

Key Features

  • Frontend user login form for easy access
  • View, add, edit, and delete posts directly from the front-end
  • Display and manage posts in a customizable list
  • Easy media uploads with preview support.
  • Manage and update user profile information
  • Displays a custom status message and the time elapsed since the status was last updated.
  • Responsive and user-friendly design.
  • Seamless integration with WordPress for smooth functionality

Shortcode

This plugin offers two powerful [/] shortcodes for seamless frontend user interaction:

  1. [rwc-user-frontend]: This is the core [/] shortcode of the plugin. It displays the user profile, custom status, post lists, and enables users to manage their profile, update their status, and handle posts, including creating, editing, and deleting posts directly from the frontend.
  2. [rwc-user-status]: This [/] shortcode allows users to display their custom status on the frontend. While the main [/] shortcode helps users update their custom status, this [/] shortcode lets you show the user’s custom status anywhere on your website.

For a detailed guide on how to use these [/] shortcodes effectively, please refer to the plugin’s help page.

Why Use This Plugin?

  • Simplify post management by handling everything from the front-end
  • No need to access the WordPress dashboard for managing posts and profiles
  • Streamline user login and profile updates with an easy-to-use interface
  • Save time and improve workflow with a seamless front-end experience
  • Designed for users who prefer a front-end solution for managing content

This plugin is ideal for blogs, membership sites, and any platform that requires a frontend user interface.

Support

For any queries, feedback, or assistance, please visit our Plugin Support Page. We’re here to help you make the most of the plugin.

sections.installation:
RWC User Frontend plugin can be installed in two convenient ways: manually or directly from the WordPress plugin directory.

Manual Installation:

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file from the official source.
  2. Extract the rwc-user-frontend folder.
  3. Upload the extracted folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory on your WordPress site using FTP.
  4. Go to your WordPress admin dashboard and navigate to Plugins > Installed Plugins.
  5. Locate the RWC User Frontend plugin and click Activate.

Installation from WordPress Plugin Directory:

  1. Log in to your WordPress admin dashboard.
  2. In the left menu, navigate to Plugins > Add New.
  3. In the search bar, type RWC User Frontend Realwebcare and press Enter.
  4. Find the plugin in the search results and click the Install Now button.
  5. Once the installation completes, click Activate to enable the plugin.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin support custom post types?

Currently, the plugin only supports the default WordPress posts.

Can I manage user roles and capabilities with this plugin?

No, this plugin does not manage user roles or capabilities. It operates based on the default WordPress role system.

Who can submit posts using this plugin?

By default, users with the “Author” role or higher can submit posts. This plugin follows the standard WordPress capabilities.

Can users edit or delete their posts?

Yes, logged-in users can add, edit, and delete their posts directly from the front-end.

Can users manage their profiles?

Users can view and update their name, bio and custom status in their profiles. However, full profile management (e.g., changing roles) is not available.
